newsitem.title: USA: Kitty Hawk signs freight deal with Ansett.
newsitem.headline: Kitty Hawk signs freight deal with Ansett.

text.p: Kitty Hawk Inc said Tuesday that it will receive about $4.7 million per year as a result of a three-year contract it has signed to provide daily charter air freight service between Auckland, New Zealand and Sydney, Australia for Ansett Air Freight.
The company said the service began July 7. Ansett Air Freight is a subsidiary of Ansett Australia Ltd, an airline owned by Air New Zealand and News Corp Ltd.

Kitty Hawk said a Boeing 727-200 cargo aircraft is making five round-trip flights a week, carrying freight and mail, and that it will operate and insure the aircraft, and provide the crew. The company also said it has contracted with Air New Zealand to perform maintenance services.
Operating its own and leased aircraft, Kitty Hawk provides on-demand air cargo charter service throughout North America, South America, Europe and the Pacific Rim.
